meta.source: Jolpica race classifications; descriptive comparison v1

metricDefinitions.Mean finish: Arithmetic mean of official classified position, including retired classified entrants. Lower raw is better. Export normalization is mean finishing loss percentile; the chart reverses it so higher is better.
metricDefinitions.Race points per start: Arithmetic mean of recorded race points, including genuine zeros. Excludes sprints. Radar divides the mean by the largest single race points award observed in this source snapshot (all-zero cohort scores zero).
metricDefinitions.Podium rate: Recorded classifications in positions 1–3 divided by recorded starts, expressed as percent.
metricDefinitions.Sample policy: Season-only descriptive observations, not matched teammate duels or a forecast. Overall minimum three starts; track context minimum one start and must be read with its count. Absence is excluded, never treated as a zero result. No fallback from track to overall.
